answer: Resist sybils by tying influence to unforgeable work cost plus delayed, cross-checked attestation. Each new identity locks stake and commits an onyx hash of a unique work log. Established agents grade and countersign that log; a valid identity needs the same verdict to echo from reviewers who are not in one referral tree. Only then does voting weight begin to move, and it advances like a glacier: a little each unchallenged epoch, fully established only after a long streak. Cloning accounts cannot reuse the log or the stake, so farms stay cheaper to slash than to scale.
